name: Imce File Manager
description: Provides a file manager supporting personal folders.

suggests.drupal/bueditor: IMCE ships a BUEditor plugin so it can act as the file/image browser for BUEditor.

project_description:
IMCE is a file manager featuring personal directories and quotas.

 Features 
 
 Upload/delete files, resize images. 
 Support for file systems: private, s3, google 
 Configuration per role: file size/type, personal directories, quota 
 Editor integrations: CKEditor, BUEditor , plain textareas. See README.txt for instructions. 
 
 Theme/Js issues 
 Enable "Use admin theme for IMCE paths" option under Common settings at admin/config/media/imce if you're experiencing theme issues.
